response.justification: Bogdan has impressive full-stack and distributed-systems expertise, including event-driven architectures and low-latency applications, but lacks direct experience with multi-agent AI systems in fintech or regulated environments. His recent work in agentic infrastructure (MCP frameworks) is promising but not at scale. Leadership experience is present but not in a CTO capacity or fintech domain.
strengths: Strong backend and distributed-systems expertise with event-driven architectures (e.g., GISCollective, re:cinq)
Experience building scalable microservices and real-time systems (e.g., Dunnhumby, Optilyz)
Demonstrated engineering leadership and mentorship (e.g., Refactoring Dojos, Selenium course)
concerns: No direct experience with multi-agent AI systems in production or fintech infrastructure
Lacks tenure in senior technical leadership roles (e.g., no CTO or VP Engineering experience)
Limited exposure to financial regulation, credit systems, or embedded finance
